conclusions: Runtime increment is limited to authorized WeightLoader ownership/metadata/diagnostic locking and startup memory-budget/max-prefill validation.
No MoEResidency/ReadRangev/offload observer/candidate kernel implementation entered src/include or runner targets.
Historical replay/distribution JSON files contain relative private evidence references and SHA identities only; they are not raw evidence and are not executed by CTest.
run_evalscope_scenarios.py and run_shadow_study.py are explicit generic capture tools from 8602015, using current-root or caller-supplied paths; CTest does not launch their main routines.
Read-only physical RAM collector intentionally references /proc and /sys and optionally sudo/cat; public tests use synthetic/mock observations.
Local and immutable-GitHub report links were checked against local files/git objects; no remote web fetch or model execution.
limitations: Scope audit is not a correctness, numerical, performance or runtime acceptance test.
Expected unittest counts count named methods, not subTest loop iterations.
Concurrent authorized budget/server_options edits may follow this snapshot; final commit should retain reviewed identities or re-audit changed paths.
advisories: docs/README.md does not directly index the new report; STATUS, trace README and daily log link it. Existing links resolve; this is discoverability only.
